overview: A self-managing, icon-only button that pauses and resumes the LOCAL user's active screen share in Zoom Video SDK sessions. On tap it calls pauseShare() when the share is live or resumeShare() when paused, via the ZMShareManager singleton. It enables/disables itself based on whether a share is active (greyed out unless sharing), registers as a delegate observer, and automatically keeps its icon and enabled state synchronized with the authoritative SDK share status.

typeDefinitions.note: Case names describe the CURRENT state, not the tap action. In .playing (live) a tap pauses; in .paused a tap resumes.

prerequisites: Zoom Video SDK initialized and registered with the toolkit via ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize(videoSDK:bundleId:) BEFORE constructing the button.
A share must be actively sent out (shareHelper.isScreenSharingOut() == true) for the button to be enabled and taps to be meaningful.
Construct and use on the main thread (@MainActor).
lifecycle.ifNotInitialized: If ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK is nil, ZMShareManager.shared.isSharing is false, so the button constructs in the 'playing' state and is DISABLED. pauseShare()/resumeShare() return .Errors_Wrong_Usage when the share helper is nil.

actions: read ZMShareManager.shared.isPaused to choose initial state/icon
build descriptor (40x40, clear bg, secondaryLabel icon color, zero padding, iconname ResumeShare if paused else PauseShare)
entryPoints.note: The initial icon and enabled state are set inline at construction.

lifecycle.delegateModel: The button does NOT assign itself to ZoomVideoSDK.delegate. It registers with the toolkit fan-out delegate ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate (CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate), enabling multiple observers. Child delegates are stored weakly.

onUserShareStatusChanged.stateTransition: any -> matches SDK share status; isEnabled tracks isSharing
onUserShareStatusChanged.callback: onUserShareStatusChanged is fired (filtered to local user only)
notes: Resync occurs only when the changed user equals the local user.
If the share stops, isSharing becomes false and the button becomes disabled.
If the share is paused/resumed externally, the icon updates to match.

tapHandlerNote: The tap callback branches on ZMShareManager.shared.isPaused (re-queried at tap time). It first guards on ZMShareManager.shared.isSharing and takes no action when no share is active; the button is disabled in that case. On a non-success error from pauseShare()/resumeShare(), no optimistic icon change is made.

resyncRule.isPausedDefinition: ZMShareManager.shared.isPaused is true only when isSharing AND the local user's getShareActionList() contains an action whose getShareStatus() == .pause (ZoomVideoSDKReceiveSharingStatus_Pause).

apis.name: init
apis.description: Reads ZMShareManager.shared.isPaused to choose initial state/icon, constructs the button, sets isEnabled from ZMShareManager.shared.isSharing, and registers as a delegate observer. The initial icon and enabled state are set inline.

apis.name: init(coder:)
apis.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Calls fatalError. Do not instantiate from Storyboard/XIB.

apis.name: setPauseShareIcon
apis.description: Overrides the icon used for the 'playing' state (the live/pause-affordance icon). Applied immediately if currently in the playing state.
sideEffects: Updates pauseIcon; calls switchTo(.playing) if currentType == .playing

apis.name: setResumeShareIcon
apis.description: Overrides the icon used for the 'paused' state (the paused/resume-affordance icon). Applied immediately if currently in the paused state.
sideEffects: Updates playIcon; calls switchTo(.paused) if currentType == .paused

apis.name: switchTo
apis.description: Sets currentType and updates the displayed image (pauseIcon for .playing, playIcon for .paused). Internal; documented for completeness.
sideEffects: Sets currentType and the normal-state image

apis.name: syncCurrentState
apis.description: Refreshes isEnabled from ZMShareManager.shared.isSharing and recomputes the icon state from ZMShareManager.shared.isPaused, then calls switchTo(type:). Called from didMoveToWindow and onUserShareStatusChanged.

apis.name: didMoveToWindow
apis.description: UIView override. Refreshes the icon and enabled state to the current SDK share state when the button is attached to the view hierarchy.

inheritedConfiguration.note: Use the per-state setPauseShareIcon / setResumeShareIcon methods to represent pause/resume state; setIcon/setImage set the raw image directly and are replaced on the next resync.

callbacks.name: onUserShareStatusChanged
callbacks.signature: public func onUserShareStatusChanged(_ helper: ZoomVideoSDKShareHelper?, user: ZoomVideoSDKUser?, shareAction: ZoomVideoSDKShareAction?)
callbacks.description: Fired when any user's share status changes (start, pause, resume, stop). Filters to the local user (changed user == getSession()?.getMySelf()) and calls syncCurrentState(), refreshing both the enabled flag (from isSharing) and the icon (from isPaused). Primary mechanism for authoritative state.
callbacks.stateChange: resyncs icon to match isPaused and isEnabled to match isSharing, for local-user changes only
inactiveConditions: user is not the local user
callbacks.parameterUsage: The button re-queries ZMShareManager.shared to derive state.

errorHandling.strategy: The tap callback inspects the ZoomVideoSDKError returned by ZMShareManager.shared.pauseShare()/resumeShare(). The icon is updated optimistically ONLY on .Errors_Success; otherwise no UI change is made and the authoritative onUserShareStatusChanged callback reconciles state. The tap handler branches on isPaused (re-queried), guards on isSharing, and takes no action when no share is active.

perAction.onFailure: no UI change; rely on delegate resync
no UI change; rely on delegate resync

shareManagerFailureModes.Errors_Wrong_Usage: Returned immediately by ZMShareManager.pauseShare()/resumeShare() when the share helper is nil (SDK not available / not registered).
shareManagerFailureModes.otherSdkError: Otherwise the ZoomVideoSDKError from shareHelper.pauseShare()/resumeShare() is returned directly.

errorHandling.retryStrategy: None built in. The button does not surface errors. Integrators should observe SDK errors via their own ZoomVideoSDKDelegate registered with ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).
recoveryActions: Authoritative state reconciled by onUserShareStatusChanged for the local user

required: Initialize the toolkit (ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize) before constructing the button.
Construct and use the button on the main thread.
forbidden: Instantiating via init?(coder:) / Interface Builder (traps with fatalError).
Assigning the button (or anything) directly to ZoomVideoSDK.delegate; use ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).
Using inherited setIcon/setImage to represent pause/resume state; it is replaced on the next resync.
notes: Pause/resume only applies to the local user's own share; the button does not control or reflect remote participants' shares.
The button is disabled (greyed out) whenever no share is active.
